title: Accidental Damage Coverage Terms by Loan Type, Student Technology Device Program
content:
Under the Student Technology Device Program each loan type states what is charged for accidental damage under the Technology Protection Plan, what is charged for damage without the plan and for damage the campus finds intentional, whether chargers and cases are covered by the plan, and how many damage incidents in a school year bring take-home use to review by the campus administrator.

## Coverage terms

| Loan type | First accidental damage incident of the school year under the plan (USD) | Second accidental damage incident of the school year under the plan (USD) | From the third incident of the school year under the plan | Any damage without the plan | Damage the campus finds intentional, with or without the plan | Chargers and cases covered by the plan | Damage incidents in a school year at which take-home use is reviewed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 25.00 | 100.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | Full repair cost | No | 3 |

## Terms in plain words

- The first-incident and second-incident figures are the charges for the first and the second accidental damage incident of the school year under the plan. From the third incident of the school year under the plan, the charge basis is the full repair cost.
- The charge basis for any damage without the plan is the full repair cost, on every loan type.
- Damage the campus finds intentional is charged on the full repair cost basis on every loan type, with or without the plan.
- No loan type covers chargers or cases under the plan.
- On every loan type, take-home use is reviewed by the campus administrator when damage incidents in a school year reach 3.

## The plan charge figures side by side

| Plan loan type | First incident | Second incident | Third and later |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 0.00 | 50.00 | Full repair cost |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 25.00 | 100.00 | Full repair cost |
